# Battery Cell Performance Characterization - Test Dataset B00

## 1. Operating Specifications and Protocol
This experimental report documents the electrochemical cycling, thermal behavior, and
operational parameters for commercial lithium-ion test cells evaluated under laboratory validation protocols.

The laboratory data dictionary defines positive values on the current channel as charge direction.
Interval metadata for the temperature includes a timestamp column, without clarifying whether the sample is taken at the start, end or midpoint.
The interval semantics for the current are defined as closed at both the start and the end.
The voltage is captured under a continuous streaming protocol that does not employ discrete sampling triggers, rendering the sampling-policy question moot.

Baseline environmental chamber temperature was maintained at 25.0 C across all test runs.

The README states that the voltage channel contains measured instrument readings.
The test index is recovered from the deposit via: explicit_index_column.

### 1.1 Detailed Instrumentation and Channel Mapping
Galvanostatic cycling was conducted using an automated multi-channel battery test system.

Channel voltages were calibrated against secondary standards prior to dataset acquisition.

Completeness of the current records is verified using: completeness_counter.
Deposit documentation mentions a unit-related attribute on the current channel yet never writes out the concrete unit string.
For the discharge capacity the stored numeric values undergo no scaling conversion.

## 2. Archival Summary and End of Report
Validation dataset B00 concluded without hardware interrupt flags.

---
End of Report B00.
